name: Wakupator
description_en: Wake On LAN Machine Manager based on network traffic. `MIT` `C`
description: Automatically starts machines based on incoming traffic, using smart local IP spoofing and Wake-on-LAN.
readme_preview:
A service that allow machines on the same LAN to be automatically woken up, using IP address spoofing for a good cause. Lightweight, no dependencies, non-intrusive, and easy to integrate.
